tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal bu maṅga la la gtam du bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal bu maṅga la la gtam du bya ba/ bkra shis kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis yid 'ong dpal gyi sku mnga' zhing*// bkra shis 'gag med kun tu 'jug pa'i gsung*// bkra shis mkhyen brtses rol pa'i thugs mnga' ba// bkra shis phun tshogs sangs rgyas dpal la 'dud// rgyal sras gzhon nu bkra shis mtshan ldan pas// nye bar bskul nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang*// lung dang rigs pa yis kyang rnam dpyad nas// bkra shis rnam par spel nas dbul bar bgyi// 'di ltar khyod kyis brnyes pa'i mtho ris kyi// dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa gang lags pa// nyid kyi rang dbang bsnams nas byon min te// sku yang gzhan gyis bskyed nas bskrun phyir ro// gnam dang lha dang phya zhes grags pa yi// byed pos bgyis pa min te rtag pa dang*// byed por 'gal zhing 'jig rten don phal cher// rtsol ba'i rjes su 'brang bar mthong phyir ro// de slad 'jig rten bde sdug phal che ba// las las byung zhes thub pas gang gsungs de// rigs pa yis kyang grub pa de bas na// gang gis bde bgyis dge ba'i las rnams la// gus par mdzod cig lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen// yab yum brgyud par bcas dang de bzhin du// gang gis cung zad phan bgyis de dag la'ang*// 'phral du drin la lan du blan par bgyi// de yis sngon gyi dge ba nyer 'phel zhing*// nyid kyi rjes su gzhan yang rjes 'brangs pas// bdag gzhan kun gyi dge 'phel de las ni// phyogs mthar gtugs pa'i bkra shis 'byung lags grang*// rigs dang gzugs dang shes rab longs spyod dang*// dbang phyug nad med pa dang tshe ring ba// mtho ris yon tan bdun du thub pa yis// rab tu bka' stsal de dag bskyang bar bgyi// rigs kyi phul du khyod ni nyer 'khrungs mod// 'on kyang mdzad spyod dge bas dag bgyi ste// spyod pa med na rigs don nyams so zhes// gtsug lag dag las legs par 'byung phyir ro// 'jig rten pa yi dge spyod de yang ni// chang mi 'thung dang 'tsho ba dag pa dang*// rnam mi 'tshe dang mchod 'os mchod pa dang*// nyams thag sbyin pas rjes su bskyang ba'o zhes// 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas gsungs shing*// gzhan yang khrel yod ngo tshas legs bsdams nas// kun gyis smad pa'i las las ldog pa dang*// bsngags pa'i las rnams dag la rab brtson zhing*// gzhan dag gis ni sngon chad ma bgyis pa// gang zhig mthong ba'i ba spu ldang 'gyur zhing*// kun la mi gnod kun du phan 'gyur pa// gtsug lag mchod rten kun dga' ra ba dang*// phongs pa rnams kyi bsti gnas legs bgyis pas// grags pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo bgyid pa// de 'dra kho na lags pa de slad du// de 'dras nyid kyi cho 'brang gsal bar mdzod// rang gis nyer spyad bya phyir khang bzangs dang*// nye ba'i khang bzangs khrus kyi khang pa dang*// rta babs skyed mos tshal dang bkod ma sogs// shin tu rgya chen rmad du byung ba gang*// mang po'i tshogs kyis 'bad nas sgrub bgyid pas// gnas skabs dga' dang ngo mtshar skyed lags kyang*// rang gis rang gi bsnyen bkur lhag bgyis pa// sngon bsags pa yi dge ba bas bgyid cing*// slar zhing sred pa 'phel 'gyur de slad du// de 'dra'i tshul la shin tu bag yod mdzod// ci bder grub la kha na ma tho med// gzhan gyis bstabs pa tshul bzhin spyad par bgyi// mtho ris 'byor pa rnams kyi gzhi dang ni// gru ltar srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du// phyin par bgyid pa'i rten yang gzugs lags pas// dbang po gsal dang lus stobs rgyas phyir dang*// bde la yun ring reg par gnas bgyi'i phyir// yul dus gnas skabs dag dang rjes 'brel pa'i// gsol zas sman sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis// chab kyi pad+ma bzhin du bskyang bar mdzod// khrus kyis dri ma sbyangs nas mdangs phyung zhing*// ha cang sgeg min gos gsar gyis klubs kyis// dri bzang me tog gsar pas mdzes byas la// lha yi dpal yang 'jug ces lugs las 'byung*// shes rab bdag gzhan gsal bgyid sgron ma ste// rgol ba'i spobs pa 'joms byed dpa' bo lags// snyan pa'i grags pa kun tu g.yo bgyid pa// de slad khyod kyis shes rab spel bar mdzod// skyes thob shes rab sngon gyi las rjes 'brang*// sbyangs thob shes rab rang gi rtsol ba la// rag las phyir na shin tu brtson pa yis// mkhyen rab gsal ba gsal bar mdzad du gsol// tshad mthar thug pa lus kyi yon tan yang*// sgyu rtsal mkhan bzhin sbyangs pas gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan gzhan dag gis// bsngags par bgyid pa mngon du gzigs lags na// shes rab gzugs can ma lags de slad du// tshad ma mchis phyir de yi yon tan yang*// gzhal du ma mchis phyir na thub pa bzhin// gzhal med yon tan dpal gyis 'byor par mdzod// de yang rang la dgos pa'i bstan bcos dga'// nyi ma re re tshig re gzung byas na// grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ji bzhin du// ring por mi thogs mkhas par 'gyur ro zhes// bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las 'byung bas na// de 'dra'i tshul gyis 'dzin dang gsan pa dang*// rnam par dpyod pa zhib mos legs dpyad pas// mkhyen rab yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod// gang yod na ni bdag gzhan phun tshogs shing*// gnas skabs dga' dang bde ba 'phel byed la// thabs kyis zin na srid zhi'i dpal skyed pa'i// longs spyod chud mi gsan zhing spel bar bya// gang zhig bung bas sbrang rtsi ji bzhin du// rang gis 'bad pa chen pos nyer bsags nas// spyad du med par gzhan gyis 'phrog bgyid pa// phongs pas phongs pa bsgrub pa'i longs spyod lags// gcan gzan khro bos ri dwags rnams la lta// brtse ba med par gzhan la nyer phrogs nas// spyod dang sbyin bar bgyid pa dug bcas kyi// kha zas bzhin du sdug bsngal skyed par bgyid// rtsol ba med par gzhan gyis nyer bstabs pas// mdzod dang sa yi tha gru rgyas gyur kyang*// cung zad spyod dang sbyin par mi bgyid pa'i// 'byor pa de ni rgya mtsho'i rin chen mtshungs// thog mar ci lta'i tshul gyis rnyed kyang rung*// bar du rang gis ci bder spyod bgyid cing*// gzhan dag la yang tshul bzhin yongs gtong ba// 'byor pa de ni lha yi dpal dang 'dra// gang zhig dang po lhun gyis grub gyur nas// rang gi cha tsam las ni mi spyod par// mchod 'os mchod dang dman pa legs skyong ba'i// longs spyod de ni mi zad gter chen lags// de slad srid 'bangs zhi la bka' drin gyi// sa bon yul dang 'tsham par legs stsal nas// tshul bzhin 'chos pa'i so nam rab bgyis te// khrims su bca' ba dam pos bsrungs bgyis nas// de las de yi dpal 'byor gang bskrun las// bzhon las 'o ma dang ni sā la yi// shing las spos bzhin dus su ran pa dang*// 'tshe med sdud dang 'tsham pa'i sho gam gyis// bang mdzod dam pa rnam par rgyas bgyis te// rang gis tshul bzhin dgyes dgur spyod pa dang*// gzhan la mchod cing lhug par legs gnang bas// 'di dang phyi ma'i dga' bde 'phel bar mdzod// tshong dang skyed dang gla la sogs pa yis// 'byor pa spel bgyid phal ba'i tshul lags pas// de 'dras 'tsho ba de dag bag brkyang nas// 'tshe ba med par 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol// lan tshwa la sogs sems can spyi mthun gyi// las las grub pa'i yo byad gang lags pa// de kun skye dgu so so'i rtsol ba yis// btsal nas spyod par stsal nas ji ltar dgongs// chang dang chu dang snyug ma la sogs pa// rang gi rtsol bas bsgrubs te btsongs nas su// 'tsho bgyid de dag zho shas 'tsho ba zhes// lung las bshad bzhin gnang bar rigs lags grang*// gos dang rgyan sogs nye bar spyod pa'i zong*// sngon chad med pa 'ga' zhig lha de yi// sku ring la ni byung zhes skye bo yis// kun tu bsngags 'gyur spel na 'thad par 'tshal// dge sbyong bram ze sogs kyi smon lam dang*// shes nyan ldan pas rig pas khyod bkur zhing*// 'gro mang dga' bgyid de dag bca' sogs kyis// 'tshe ba med na 'jig rten dger 'gyur lags// pad+mo yongs su rgyas pas khebs pa'i mtshor// bskrad kyang ngang pa'i tshogs 'du ji bzhin du// nyid kyi yul 'khor 'tshe med 'byor ldan par// skye dgu ngang gis 'du bar mdzad du gsol// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs la gzhan dag gis// bar du gcod par mi nus de yis ni// 'gro mang bskyab par nus pa de slad du// dbang phyug rnam par spel bgyi de yang ni// 'gums dang gzhu dang de bzhin gshe ba dang*// dbrog pa la sogs bsdigs nas btsan bcings dang*// ldan par ston de gdug pa'i sbrul mtshungs pa'i// kha na ma tho bcas pa spang bar bgyi// gang zhig rang gis drang po'i tshul spyad cing*// drang zhing rigs pa'i tshul gyis gzhan bcos pas// mi rigs spyod pa ngang gis 'jig 'gyur zhing*// rigs lam 'jug bgyid dbang phyug dam pa lags// nad med pa ni bde ba'i mchog lags pas// nyid kyang bsnyun mi mnga' bar bgyid slad du// nad 'phel ba dang lus zungs rgud bgyid pa'i// zas dang btung ba gnas dang kun spyod sogs// cha shas kyis ni rab tu spang bgyi zhing*// nad mi skyed pa'am zhi bar bgyid pa dang*// khams dang dbang po rgyas shing gsal bgyid pa'i// gnas dang yo byad spyod lam bstan par mdzod// nad pa rnams la sman dang kha zas dang*// gos dang stan sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang*// sngags sogs phan bgyid rig pa sna tshogs kyis// byams dang sri zhu bcas pas phan par mdzod// sman gyi bla dang 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// lha mo ri khrod lo ma can sogs kyi// rnal 'byor dang ni bzlas brjod brtson bgyid pa// yul 'khor dag tu mang du gzhug tu gsol// gang gis dbang gis sna tshogs nad skyed pa// mkha' 'gro sha za la sogs 'byung po'i yid// zhi bar bgyi slad mchod sbyin bgyid pa yang*// rim gror bcas te bka' yis bsgo bar mdzod// de dag gis ni nyid sku bde ba dang*// nyid kyi chabs 'og mchis pa'i 'gro kun yang*// byams pa'i stobs kyis srid 'bangs ji bzhin du// nad dang 'tshe med bde bar gnas gyur lags// tshe ring gyur na rang dang gzhan gyi don// phal cher 'grub 'gyur bde la yun ring du// reg par gnas shing chos don tshol bas kyang*// go skabs mchi slad sku tshe bsring bar bgyi// sman dang ting nge 'dzin dang gsang sngags sogs// gang zhig gis ni tshe yi gegs sel zhing*// tshe 'phel byed par gsungs pa de dag la// bsgrub pa nan tan gyis ni mdzad du gsol// 'chi bar nges pa'i srog ni bslu ba dang*// 'gro la srog gi mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang*// gzhan dag srog gcod pa las ldog pa yis// tshe yi dpal 'byor rgyas par 'gyur ba lags// tshe dpag med dang rnam rgyal la sogs kyi// rnal 'byor dang ni bzlas pa brtson bgyid pa// mang po bkur stir bcas pa nyer bsten pas// sku tshe kun du bsring bar mdzad du gsol// sngon gyi dge spyad dang ni smon lam gyis// mtho ris dpal bdun khyod kyis gang brnyes pa// 'di ltar gsol ba'i thabs tshul 'di yis ni// de dag rgyas mdzod mngon par mtho ba lags// de ltar 'jig rten pa yi dpal gyis ni// 'jig rten 'dir ni phun sum tshogs gyur nas// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal gyis bdag gzhan kun// 'byor bar bgyi slad chos lam bsten du gsol// chos de'ang brjod bya bslab pa gsum ston zhing*// ngag tshig dri med sgrub byed gsum dang ldan// thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i 'bras 'byin pa// nyid lags gzhan ni gzhan du mkhyen par mdzod// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang ni// chos kun bdag med zag bcas sdug bsngal la// mya ngan 'das pa zhi zhing bde ba'o zhes// phyag rgya rnam pa bzhi yang bka' stsal to// de dag thub dbang nyid kyi bdag rkyen las// byung ba gang de la ni bka' zhes bgyi// gang zhig thub pas gsungs pa 'ba' zhig gis// dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis byas// thar pa sgrub pa'i lam dang rjes 'brel bar// dgongs pa 'gal bgyid gang de bstan bcos te// 'di dag lung gi chos lags de bsgoms pas// goms pa lhag par son pa rtogs pa'i chos// de dag chags pa bral bgyid lam dang ni// de yis chags bral bgyid pa 'gog chos lags// chos de rnams dang dpyad bgyi gzhan rnams la// gang zag tshig dang drang don rnam shes la// ming don chos don nges pa'i don dang ni// ye shes rton pa rton pa bzhir gsungs pas// gnyis po dag la gsum gyis rnam dpyad nas// bzhi la rton zhing tshul bzhi la zhugs pas// thob par bgyi ba'i chos lnga rim bzhin du// thob bgyid de ni nges par legs pa'i chos// 'di yis brgyad dang rnam gsum mngon du bgyid// de yang theg pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa las// theg pa chung ngu'i chos kyi tshul gyis ni// rang nyid zhi bar bgyid pa lags mod kyi// sangs rgyas thob par bgyid pa ma lags pas// bsnyen gnas sogs la ci nus brtson par mdzod// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro tshe rings lha// kla klor skyes dang log par lta ba dang*// rgyal pas stong par skyes dang lkugs pa ste// mi khom gnas brgyad dag las thar bgyi'i slad// yid gang 'dod chags bcas dang zhe sdang dang*// gti mug bcas pa yis ni kun bslang nas// srog gcod rku dang log par g.yem pa dang*// rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang*// brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste// nag po'i las bcur gsungs pa spang bgyis nas// mir gyur yul dbus skyes dang dbang po tshang*// gnas la dad dang las mtha' ma log dang*// zhing der sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsung dang*// bstan pa gnas dang rjes sgrub yod pa dang*// de yi brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa ste// 'byor pa bcu pos kun nas 'byor bgyi'i slad// ma chags pa dang zhe sdang med pa dang*// gti mug med pas kun nas bslang pa yi// srog la byams dang longs spyod gtong ba dang*// ma chags pa dang bden par smra ba dang*// mthun par byed dang snyan dang don ldan smra// chog shes phan 'dod yang dag lta ba ste// dkar po'i las kyi lam bcur gsungs pa la// rnam pa kun tu 'bad pas bsgrub tu gsol// gzhan yang yi ge 'dri dang mchod pa dang*// sbyin dang nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton sems dang sgom pa ste// chos spyod bcu yang ci nus dag tu mdzod// theg chen bdud rtsi'i sgo mo'ang skyabs 'gro zhes// thub pas bka' stsal de yang 'khor ba dang*// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las bdag gzhan bskyab phyir dang*// yul la dad pas de 'dra bgyi slad du// skyabs kyi gtso bo'i go 'phang brnyes kyi bar// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// theg mchog la sogs dam chos thams cad dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun la skyabs gsol nas// skyabs ma yin la skyob par mi 'dzin zhing*// skyes bu dam pa rnams dang 'grogs pa dang*// de las dam pa'i chos rnams gsan pa dang*// chos bzhin bsgrub la kun du brtson par mdzod// snying rje chen po'i rgyu las byung gyur zhing*// yang dag shes pa'i rtogs pas dbang byas pa'i// spro ba che dang rtsom pa che bdag nyid// byang chub sems mchog yang yang bskyed bgyis nas// nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa las// ji ltar bka' stsal bzhin du bslab bya rnams// mkhyen zhing bslab par mdzod cig ci gsungs pa'i// phan yon thams cad myur du brnyes 'gyur lags// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad nad dang ni// las dang nyon mongs kun 'byung nad rgyu dang*// 'gog pa nad med bde bar gnas pa dang*// lam ni 'tsho ba'i sman 'drar mkhyen bgyis nas// thugs 'byung ba dang kun nas spang ba dang*// shin tu 'dun dang bsgrub la nan tan mdzod// 'di ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi zhes gsungs// chos rnams kun gyi sdom yang 'di lags so// skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi ba ni// sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi lags bsags pa yi// mtha' 'dzad mthon po'i mtha' ni dma' ba dang*// 'tsho mtha' 'chi dang 'dus mtha' 'bral ba ni// 'khor ba'i mtha' bzhir gsungs pa de dag las// bdag nyid bsnyengs shing gzhan la thugs brtse dang*// bdag nyid rgal nas gzhan dag sgrol ba dang*// bdag nyid thar nas gzhan dag drang du gsol// ma rig pa las 'du byed de las ni// rnam par shes pa de las ming dang gzugs// de las skye mched drug 'byung de las reg

/de las tshor dang de las sred pa 'byung*// de las len pa len las srid pa dang*// srid las skye ba skye las na dang rga// 'chi dang mya ngan smre sngags 'di mi bde// sdug bsngal phung po brgyud mar 'byung 'gyur zhing*// dngos po rnam par dpyad pas ma rig 'gag /de yis 'du byed la sogs rim bzhin du// nye bar 'gags nas sdug bsngal mthar byed pa// de dag rten cing 'byung ba'i tshul gnyis lags// ji ltar snang ba 'di ni rkun rdzob ste// de yi rang bzhin spros bral don dam lags// de don dpyad cing sgom pa goms bgyis pas// lung dang rtogs pa'i chos la dbang bsgyur bgyid// 'dod chags la sogs thar lam sgrib byed dang*// 'khor gsum rtogs pas kun mkhyen la sgrib pa'i// sgrib pa de dag so so'i gnyen po dang*// lam gyi yon tan dam par bsgyur du gsol// mthun par gyur pa'i yul du dge ba yi// bshes dang 'grogs nas sgrub pa nan tan du// mdzad nas smon lam dam pa legs 'debs pa'i// 'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan par mdzod// rnyed dang ma rnyed bde dang mi bde dang*// snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad chos brgyad po// mgo snyoms pa la goms mdzod de dag kun// dge ba'i rkyen 'byung zhi bar bgyid pa'ang lags// sgrub byed gtong dang tshul khrims gnas skabs 'bras// lha dang mthar thug 'bras bu dang ni skyabs// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nyid lags pas// so so'i yon tan rjes su dran par mdzod// dad dang gtong dang tshul khrims thos pa dang*// ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab rnams// 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob bgyid de srid du'ang*// dpal dang bde ba skyed pas 'phags pa yi// nor bdun zhes byar 'phags mchog gis gsungs pas// nor mchog de dag gis ni rtag par nyid// 'byor par mdzod cig nyid la rten pa yi// skye bo gzhan yang 'byor par 'gyur lags grang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab 'di dag srid zhi yi// pha rol phyin bgyid pha rol phyin drug gis// srid dang zhi ba'i pha rol gshegs par mdzod// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa yi// sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi po stsal bgyi zhing*// mi dge sdom dang dge ba'i chos sdud dang*// sems can don byed khrims la bslab par bgyi// mi 'byed ji mi snyam dang nges sems pa'i// bzod pa gsum gyis nyid thugs zhi bar mdzod// go cha dang ni tshul bzhin rab zhugs dang*// ma zhum mi 'khrug chog mi shes pa yi// brtson 'grus lnga la kun du brtson bgyis pa// dkar po'i chos kun yongs sa bsdu bgyi zhing*// spong dang bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan rnam gnyis kyis// thugs zhi ba dang yon tan rnam 'phel mdzod// tho bsam sgom las byung ba'i blo gsum gyis// kun rdzob don dam shes pa'i shes rab gnyis// rnam par bskyed nas chos rnams kun la dbang*// yongs su sgyur ba'i dbang phyug dam par mdzod// stong pa mtshan ma med dang smon pa med// 'dus ma byas rnams rnam thar sgo bzhi ste// 'di ltar shes pas shes rab pha rol phyin// de ltar mnyam 'jog gang de bsam gtan lags// thabs mkhas smon lam stobs dang ye shes bzhi// drug po re re la yang tshang bgyi zhing*// mthar ni bzhi po so sor bsgrub bgyis pas// sa rnams bcu po mthar phyin bgyis pa lags// zang zing snyan par smra dang don mthun dang*// don spyod ces bgyi bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis// 'gro mang bsdus nas don chen mdzad du gsol// de nyid nyid kyi don gyi phul yang lags// lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gsum// 'phags lam bgrod la rkang mig dang mtshungs shing*// dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad 'dir 'dus pas// shin tu 'bad pa yis ni bslab par mdzod// dmigs dang dmigs pa med la mnyam 'jog pa'i// zhi gnas kyis ni ting 'dzin bsgrub bgyi zhing*// don la rnam par dpyod pa'i lhag mthong gis// shes rab ye shes yongs su dag par bgyi// spros dang bcas pas bsod nams tshogs dang ni// de bzhin spros pa med pa'i ye shes dang*// zung du 'jug pas zung 'jug 'phel bgyis pas// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor par mdzod// 'dod 'dun gnod sems gnyid rmugs rgod 'gyod dang*// the tshom zhes bgyi sgrib pa rnam lnga po// bsam gtan bde ba thob pa'i gags lags pas// de dag cha shas kyis ni spang bgyis nas// yul gyi mchog la dad pa rnam gsum dang*// dman pa la ni snying rje gsum dang yang*// byang chub sems mchog rnam pa gsum po la// mnyam par gzhag pa'i ting 'dzin goms par mdzod// byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms te// tshad med bzhi yi bsgom pa goms bgyis na// tshangs pa'i gnas pa dpe med rgya chen dang*// rgyal ba'i tshad med bzhi yang thob par bgyid// rtog dang dpyod dang bcas dang dga' bder bcas// bde ba tsam dang btang snyoms yongs dag pa'i// ting nge 'dzin de gzungs khams gtogs pa yi// bsam gtan bzhi po dag dang de bzhin du// nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*// ci yang med dang yod min med min te// gzugs med gtogs pa'i skye mched rnam bzhi dang*// 'gog pa dang ni snyoms 'jug rnam dgu dang*// gzugs can gzugs med gzugs la blta ba dang*// sdug pa mngon byas mkha' dang rnam shes dang*// ci yang med dang yod min med min dang*// 'gog pa zhes bya'i rnam thar brgyad po dang*// ting 'dzin yul du phyi nang zad par ni// sa chu me rlung sngon po ser po dang*// dmar po dkar po nam mkha' rnam shes su// bsgom pa zhes bgyi zad par bcu dang ni// gzugs su 'du shes ldan pa phyi yi gzugs// phra dang rags dang gzugs med 'du shes pas// chung dang chen po'i gzugs dang de bzhin du// sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po la// lta zhing zil gnon skye mched brgyad rnams la// mnyam gzhag rnal 'byor goms pas so so yi// spang bya'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing rab bsregs nas// ting 'dzin snang ba dam pa thob par mdzod// lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems rnams la// mi gtsang sdug bsngal bdag med mi rtag dang*// rang bzhin med par mkhyen nas dran par mdzod// 'di bzhis tshogs lam chung ngu bgrod par bgyid// dge ba skyed dang srung dang de bzhin du// mi dge mi skyed pa dang spong ba ste// brtson 'grus gtogs pa'i yang dag spong ba bzhis// tshogs lam 'bring po mthar phyin mdzad du gsol// 'dun dang dpyod dang dran pa dang ni sems// ting 'dzin rtogs pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhis// tshogs lam chen po'i 'jug ngogs bgrod par bgyid// dad dang brtson 'grus dran dang ting 'dzin dang*// shes rab dbang po lnga ste 'di dag gis// dge ba'i chos rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*// drod dang rtse mo mthar phyin bgyid pa lags// de dag stobs su gyur pa stobs lnga ste// lam gyi mi mthun phyogs rnams 'joms bgyid cing*// bzod dang chos mchog dag ste de rnams kyis// sbyor ba'i lam rnams bgrod par mdzad du gsol// dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang*// dga' dang yongs sbyangs ting 'dzin btang snyoms te// byang chub yan lag bdun gyis mthong ba'i lam// kun du gzigs nas rnam grol brnyes par mdzod// de tshe 'tsho bas gtugs dang 'chi ba dang*// mi bsngags ngan 'gror 'khor gyis 'jigs pa ste// bag tsha'i gnas lnga po 'di rnam spangs nas// 'phags mchog rnams dang spyod yul gcig gyur lags// yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang*// dran dang ting 'dzin ngag dang las kyi mtha'// rtog pa dang ni 'phags pa'i lam brgyad kyis// sgom pa'i lam rnams mthar phyin bgyid pa lags// lam de'ang sa bcus rab tu phye ba ste// rab dga' dri med 'od byed 'od 'phro dang*// sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring du song ba dang*// mi g.yo legs pa'i blo gros chos sprin no// rab dgar gnas pas dus gcig nyid la ni// ting 'dzin brgya thob de la 'jug pa dang*// sangs rgyas brgya mthong de yi byin rlabs rig

/zhing brgyar 'gro zhing 'jig rten khams brgya bsgul// de brgya snang byed 'gro brgya smin par byed// bskal pa brgyar gnas sngon dang phyi mthar 'jug /chos brgya 'byed cing lus brgya ston pa dang*// lus re'ang byang chub sems dpa' brgya phrag gi /'khor gyis yongs su bskor bar ston pa ste// 'di dag yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis lags// de dag dri ma med la gnas pa nas// bcu pa'i bar la gnas pa'i rim bzhin du// stong dang 'bum dang bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba phrag stong bye ba phrag 'bum dang*// bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum dag dang ni// 'jig rten 'bum gyi rdul dang mnyam pa dang*// de bzhin 'jig rten grangs med 'bum rdul dang*// 'jig rten mtha' yas rdul dang mnyam pa thob// de mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// gnas ngan len gyi dri ma kun spangs nas// bgrod par bgyi pa'i lam gyi mthar gtugs pa// 'di ni mthar phyin pa yi lam zhes bgyi// de tshe bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib spangs nas// dbyings dang ye shes kun du ro gcig pa// 'di ni spang ba phun sum tshogs pa ste// de nyid rang bzhin chos kyi sku yang lags// zag med dbyings las rnam par ma g.yos bzhin// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs smon lam legs sgrub pas// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par// ye shes dag pa'i snang ba la dmigs pa// 'og min zhes bya'i zhing khams 'jig med par// chos kyi sprin la gnas pa rgya mtsho yi// tshogs la theg mchog kho na'i chos gsung zhing*// phyi ma'i mur thug med pa'i dus kyi bar// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang thabs cig tu// zag pa med pa'i dga' bde la spyod pa'i// sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lags te// lus gnas gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku// phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs// phyag dang zhabs sor drwa bas 'brel pa dang*// phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// thub pa'i sku yi mdun dag mtho ba dang*// sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*// zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs// byin pa e na ya 'dra phyag ring mdzes// 'dom gyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog

/pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*// spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*// zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge'i 'dra// phyag gi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas// ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog nyid du snang*// sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// gtsug tor 'bur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*// tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems// shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang*// grangs ni bzhi bcu tham par tshang ba dang*// spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi /'dra ba'i mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyis mtshan// sen mo zangs mdog snum zhing dbyibs mtho zlum// sor mo rab tu rgyas shing byin gyis phra// rtsa mi mngon dang rtsa mdud med pa dang*// long bu mi mngon zhabs mthil kun nas mnyam// seng ge glang chen ngang pa'i rgyal po dang*// khyu mchog stabs dang g.yas kyi phyogs nas gshegs// mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags pa'i sku// byi dor byas 'drar rab mdzes rim pa 'tsham// gtsang 'jam rnam dag mtshan rnams yongs su rdzogs// sku yi kho lag yangs shing rab tu bzang*// gom snyoms spyan ni rnam dag gzhon sha chags// ma zhum rab rgyas shin tu grims pa'i sku// yan lag rnam dbyes gzigs pa rab rib med// dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs pa yi sku// phyal ni phyal le ba dang lte ba zab// g.yas su 'khyil dang kun nas rab tu mdzes// kun spyod rab gtsang sku la sme ba med// phyag ni shing bal lta bur shin tu 'jam// phyag gi ri mo mdangs gsal zab cing ring*// zhal ni ha cang mi ring 'tsham pa dang*// zhal sgros bim pa ltar dmar ljags mnyen srab// zangs mdog ltar dmar 'brug gi sgra dang ni// gsung mnyen mche ba zlum rno rab dkar mnyam// byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho rnam par dag /spyan yangs rdzi ma rab stug dkar nag 'byes// smin tshugs ring 'jam snum zhing spu ni mnyam// phyag rgyas snyan mnyam ma nyams dpral ba 'byes// dbyes che dbu rgyas dbu skra bung ba'i mdog

/stug 'jam ma 'dzings mi bshor dri zhim dang*// phyag zhabs g.yung drung dpal gyi be'us mtshan// 'di dag dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste// de 'dras mgon de'i sku mchog mdzes pa lags// ngag gnas gyur ba 'gag pa med pa'i gsung*// dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus brgyan pa ste// mnyen dang 'jam dang yid 'ong yid du 'thad// dag dang dri med gsal dang 'jebs pa dang*// mnyan 'os mi tshugs snyan dang dul ba dang*// mi rtsub mi brlang rab dul rnam par 'bab// lus tshim sems tshim yid dga' byed pa dang*// dga' bde skyed dang gdung sel kun shes byed// rnam par rig bya rnam gsal dga' ba skyed// mngon par dga' dang kun shes rnam rig byed// rigs pa dang ni 'brel dang zlos skyon bral// seng ge glang chen 'brug gi sgra dbyangs dang*// klu dbang dri za ka la piṅga dang*// tshangs dbyangs shang shang te'u'i sgra ltar snyan// lha dbang dbyangs dang rnga sgra lta bur brji// ma khengs mi dma' sgra kun rjes zhugs dang*// tshig zur ma chag ma tshang med pa dang*// ma zhum mi zhan rab tu dga' ba dang*// khyab dang tha bar bcas pa'i ched dang ni// rgyun chags 'brel dang sgra kun rdzogs byed dang*// dbang po tshim byed ma smad mi 'gyur dang*// ma rtabs pa dang nye 'khor kun tu grags// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa yi// zab cing rgya che'i chos tshul ston par mdzad// yid gnas gyur pa gnyis su med pa'i thugs// ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen pa yi// ye shes gnyis dang rten las kyis phye bas// chos kyi dbyings dang me long lta bu dang*// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor kun du rtog /bya grub zhes bya'i ye shes lnga dang ldan// skyon gnas gyur pa zag med yon tan te// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu so bdun dang*// tshad med pa ni rnam pa bzhi po dang*// gzugs can gzugs med gzugs la lta ba dang*// sdug pa mngon byas mkha' dang rnam shes dang*// ci yang med dang yod min med min dang*// 'gog pa zhes bgyi'i rnam thar brgyad po dang*// de bzhin snyoms par 'jug pa rnam dgu dang*// sa chu me rlung sngon po ser po dang*// dmar po dkar po mkha' dang rnam shes su// sgom pa zhes bgyi zad par bcu dang ni// gzugs su 'du shes ldan pas phyi yi gzugs// phra dang rags dang gzugs dang 'du shes pas// chung dang chen po'i gzugs dang de bzhin du// sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po la// lta zhing zil gyis gnon pa zil gnon brgyad// bdag nyid nyon mongs med pas gzhan dag gi

/nyon mongs 'joms bgyid nyon mongs med pa dang*// smon pas shes bya'i chos kun lhun grub tu// mkhyen nas the tshom kun gcod smon mkhyen dang*// rdzu 'phrul lha yi mig dang rna ba dang*// pha rol sems dang sngon gyi gnas dang ni// zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa zhes bgyi ba'i// mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug dang ni// bshad bya chos dang don dang 'chad byed ni// nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa zhes bgyi pa// so so yang dag rig pa rnam bzhi dang*// rten dang dmigs pa thugs dang ye shes te// yongs su dag pa bzhi dang de bzhin du// tshe dang sems dang yo byad las dang ni// skye ba mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul dang*// ye shes chos la dbang ba zhes bgyi pa// dbang bcu dag tu gsungs pa de dag dang*// gnas las khams mos dbang po kun 'gro'i lam// kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dgod pa dang*// sngon gnas rjes dran 'chi 'pho skye ba dang*// zag pa zad mkhyen 'di dag stobs bcu lags// ye shes brnyes dang spang bya spang ba dang*// nges 'byung lam dang de yi gags ston la// kun la kun du bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba// mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi zhes bgyi// sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa yongs dag pas// bcab pa mi mnga' bsrung med rnam gsum dang*// 'dun dang mi 'dun par ma gsum gyi thugs// nyon mongs mi 'gyur dran ba nyer gzhag gsum// gzhan gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' dang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa dang*// kun la phan dgongs thugs rje chen po dang*// 'khrul dang ca co mnyam par ma bzhag dang*// dran pa nyams dang tha dad 'du shes dang*// ma brtags pa yi btang snyoms mi mnga' ba// spyod pas bsdus pa rnam pa drug dang ni// 'dun dang brtson 'grus dran dang ting nge 'dzin// shes rab rnam grol ye shes ma nyams pa// rtogs pas bsdus pa drug dang dus gsum la// thogs med ye shes kyis bsdus rnam gsum dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi las rnams ye shes kyi// rjes su 'brang ba phrin las kyis bsdus pa// 'di dag ma 'dres pa yi chos bco brgyad// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la mnga' ba lags// gzhi lam bcas pa'i rnam pa kun mkhyen pa// 'di dag zag med sde tshan nyi shu gcig

/yon tan gyis ni yongs su bsdus pa ste// rtogs pa chos kyi skur yang bgrang ba lags// las gnas gyur pa rgyal ba'i phrin las te// gdul bya mngon mtho'i dpal la 'god pa dang*// theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nyer drangs nas// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob mdzad phrin las lnga// phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun gang gsungs pa// thams cad 'di yi nang du 'dus mkhyen mdzod// de 'dra gang lags lam gyis bskrun pa'i 'bras// de yis rkyen dang gdul bya sna tshogs kyis// khams kyi rgyu las so so'i skal ba bzhin// pha mtha' yas par srid pa ji srid par// sna tshogs snang bas so so'i don mdzad pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku lags te// skye dang bzo dang byang chub chen po dang*// mya ngan 'das dang sna tshogs ston pa zhes// sprul pa lnga ste rtogs pa phun tshogs lags// de lta'i thub mchog de ni chos dbyings dang*// ro gcig pa dang thog ma med pa yi// sems kyi rgyu dang bsod nams ye shes tshogs// mtha' yas rkyen las nye bar 'khrungs pa dang*// mi mthun phyogs rnams rtsad nas bcom pa dang*// chos rnams kun la dbang 'byor brnyes pa dang*// smon lam dam pa nye bar grub pa dang*// mdzad pa'i yul yang rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir// rtag brtan rgyun mi 'chad pas des bstan pa'i// chos kyang mi nub slob pa'i dge 'dun yang*// rim bzhin 'byung slad 'grib par mi 'gyur bas// skyabs su bzung nas de 'drar mdzad du gsol// gsol ba 'di ni nyid kyis 'grub par bgyi// 'di las phul gyur bgyi gzhan ma mchis la// bgyi ba 'di ni yongs su grub bgyis pas// bgyir 'os bgyis pa'i rab kyi mthar phyin to// //de ltar bstan 'di rgyal bu maṅga la'i// gsung gis bskul nas bskul ba po dang ni// skye bo gzhan gyi'ang don du 'gyur slad du// dge slong 'phags pa zhes byas rnam par sbyar// de lta mod kyi de yis lung gi chos// rgya cher ma sbyangs rtogs pa'ang ma mchis pas// 'di yi nongs pa dam pa rnams dang ni// bskul ba po la bzod par gsol zhing mchis// dge bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog

/gnas skabs skul byed yab yum sras dang bcas// bsnyun med sku tshe ring zhing dge bar shog /bkra shis rmad du 'byung ba'i 'bras 'byin pas// rab byed 'di ni bkra shis phreng ba yin// bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes byas yang yang bskul// yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bgyi// mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'i tshul gnyis gsal bar ston pa'i rab tu byed pa/ rgyal bu maṅga la la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rje/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos blangs pa'i dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ me pho byi ba'i lo bya spo'i zla ba'i tshes gcig skar ma rgyal la 'bab pa'i tshe/ mdo khams kyi sa'i char rdzogs par sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
